The Statement
Bows, jewels and a
commanding line.
66 / Bow Tartan
A brown tartan midi dress printed with
small black bows, with a square
neckline gathered by a lace-up front,
ruffled edge and a fishtail hem. Black
velvet bows in the hair and a velvet
choker complete the look against a pale
studio backdrop.
